line: CAMERA shows a part of the panel, closer, for a recording, a stream or a lesson; FOLLOW keeps the page or module you touch in view, and the sound does not change. JING FANG now signs in with your SubverseLab account in the browser, once per computer, with no key to type.
title: JING FANG 1.4: the camera, and sign in with your account.
